'''Noako''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="Crates of Krayts" /> of the [[Jiramma]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Noako became engaged in a gang war against the rival Hutt [[Sinasu]], and he hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group [[Cordol's Chain]] to attack agents of his adversary.<ref name="Crates of Krayts" />
